bound-control.limitation: A finite-box eigenvalue above 0.25 is a nonbound control. Radial Hessian diagnostics do not exclude all nonlinear or angular instabilities.
bound-control.question: Does the bound eigenvalue survive resolution controls and disappear without trapping?
bound-control.reading: Selected E/Q=0.919412; removing nu gives lowest eigenvalue 0.251711 versus 0.25 threshold. Eigen error estimate 2.82e-07.
bound-control.significance: The trapping coefficient is causally relevant to this bound mode in the registered family.

core-and-well.limitation: Flat spherical branch only; neither gravity nor nonspherical perturbations follow from this profile.
core-and-well.question: Which trial core supplies a spatial mass well and localized clock eigenfunction?
core-and-well.reading: Selected omega_Q=0.900; core center F=0.7426; clock eigenvalue 0.170362 below vacuum 0.25.
core-and-well.significance: The declared core density produces a spatially resolved clock mass well and a separately solved localized mode.

lifetime-convergence.limitation: Refined/wider runs and half/double amplitude controls cover 20 periods. An outer damping layer and untested nonspherical dynamics limit lifetime claims.
lifetime-convergence.question: Does the mode persist with controlled charge, amplitude, grid and boundary errors?
lifetime-convergence.reading: Over 100 periods mode-energy loss 2.53e-05; maximum charge ledger error 1.44e-15; short-run frequency grid/domain difference 1.01e-05.
lifetime-convergence.significance: The duration and numerical controls quantify whether this core can provisionally serve as Test 7 calibration.

local-trace.limitation: This is an ideal local field probe in the flat limit. Marker coupling, device noise and invariant reception comparison are future tests.
local-trace.question: Does a local field trace tick for 100 periods when the unexcited core does not?
local-trace.reading: Nominal local trace completes 100.00 inferred signed cycles; local frequency 0.412749 versus eigenfrequency 0.41275. Unexcited trace is zero.
local-trace.significance: Unlike the stationary core density/projector, the field sampled inside the core has a repeatable local zero-crossing record.
